EXPLANATION: Avoid shell injection by passing the process name as a separate argument to grep instead of concatenating it into a shell string.
```python
@bp.route("/grep_processes")
def grep_processes():
    import subprocess
    name = request.args.get("name", "")
    ps = subprocess.Popen(["ps", "aux"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    grep = subprocess.Popen(["grep", name], stdin=ps.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    awk = subprocess.Popen(["awk", "{print $11}"], stdin=grep.stdout, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    out, _ = awk.communicate()
    if out is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "no stdout returned"})
    out_str = out.decode("utf-8")
    names = out_str.split("\n")
    return jsonify({"success": True, "names": names})
```
